root_cause: The conditional secondary action container was a sibling after the summary/primary-action header row, so it occupied the full card width instead of the right-side action area.

before.header_layout: Nested flex row for summary and primary actions inside a full-width suggestion-action-stack.
before.secondary_action_location: Full-width sibling below the complete summary/primary-action row.
before.effect: The rerun button or completed badge appeared too low and beneath the entire header.

after.header_layout: Responsive grid with minmax(0, 1fr) summary column and auto-sized action column from the sm breakpoint.
after.summary_column: suggestion-card-summary contains badges, extracted label, page, and value metadata.
after.action_column: suggestion-action-column contains suggestion-primary-actions followed immediately by the conditional suggestion-secondary-actions.
after.secondary_action_location: Directly beneath primary actions in the same right-side action column.
after.completed_status_location: Uses the same conditional secondary action container as the rerun button.
after.empty_row_behavior: No secondary container is rendered unless the correction action is eligible or a completed revision exists.

layout_rules.action_column: flex min-w-0 max-w-full flex-col items-end gap-2
layout_rules.primary_actions: flex max-w-full flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2
layout_rules.secondary_actions: flex min-h-0 max-w-full flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2

responsive_behavior.small_screens: The grid defaults to one column, so the action column can stack below the summary.
responsive_behavior.alignment: Primary and secondary controls remain end-aligned and wrap within max-width constraints.

verification.details: Vite 5.4.21 transformed 1,585 modules. The sandboxed attempt was blocked from reading the Vite config; the approved unsandboxed rerun passed.
